subject: angol
title: You and your family
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató kérdéseket tesz fel rólad, a családodról és az otthoni életetekről. Válaszolj minden kérdésre néhány teljes mondatban, és mondj példákat is.

questions.q: Could you tell me a little about yourself? Where do you live and who do you live with?
followUps: How long have you lived there?

questions.q: How many people are there in your family? Can you describe one of them?
followUps: Who are you most similar to in your family?

questions.q: What does a typical weekday morning look like in your home?
What jobs do you do at home to help your parents?
followUps: Which job do you like the least? Why?

questions.q: How often do you see your grandparents or other relatives?
What do you usually do together as a family at the weekend?
Have you got any brothers or sisters? Do you get on well with them?
followUps: What do you sometimes argue about?

questions.q: Have you got a pet? If not, would you like one?
What are your plans for the next few years?
followUps: Where would you like to live in ten years' time?

usefulPhrases.en: I live with my parents and my younger brother.
usefulPhrases.hu: A szüleimmel és az öcsémmel élek.

usefulPhrases.en: We usually spend Sundays at my grandparents'.
usefulPhrases.hu: A vasárnapokat általában a nagyszüleimnél töltjük.

usefulPhrases.en: In the future I'd like to ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Could you tell me a little about yourself? Where do you live and who do you live with?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I live in a house in Győr with my parents, my younger sister and our dog, Morzsi. It's in a quiet street, not far from the river.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How long have you lived there?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We've lived there for about ten years. Before that we lived in a small flat in the town centre, so we were really happy when we moved to a house with a garden.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How many people are there in your family? Can you describe one of them?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: There are four of us. My dad is tall and quite serious, but he's actually very funny when you get to know him. He works as an engineer, and he loves cooking at the weekend.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What jobs do you do at home to help your parents?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I usually do the washing-up after dinner, and I walk the dog every morning. At the weekend I also vacuum my room.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you got any brothers or sisters? Do you get on well with them?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I've got a younger sister, Lili, who is twelve. We usually get on well, but we sometimes argue about the bathroom in the morning, because she spends ages in there.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre kifejtve válaszol, a családtag bemutatásánál külsőt, jellemet és szokást is említ, és apró, személyes részletekkel teszi életszerűvé a válaszokat.
Szókincs: a család és a házimunka szavai pontosak (do the washing-up, walk the dog, vacuum, get on well, argue about, spend ages).

Nyelvhelyesség: a „How long …?” kérdésre helyesen befejezett jelen idővel felel (We've lived there for about ten years), a korábbi állapotot egyszerű múlttal írja le, a „who is twelve” vonatkozó mellékmondat is hibátlan.
Érdemes megtanulni: „There are four of us.”, „he's actually very funny when you get to know him”, „We usually get on well, but …”, „she spends ages in there”.
